citation.title: Accuracy of Intraoral Scanners for Recording the Denture Bearing Areas: A Systematic Review
citation.authors: Vanya Rasaie, Jaafar Abduo, Saloumeh Hashemi

s_design.anchor: Systematic review without meta-analysis of clinical and laboratory scanner accuracy (trueness/precision) studies (DIAGNOSTIC SR/MA row, 100)
s_design.evidence_quote: The present systematic review aimed to investigate the accuracy of IOS in recording the denture-related mucosa.

domains.note: absent: read Materials and methods (PRISMA/PICO statement, Search strategy, inclusion/exclusion criteria, Selection of studies, QUADAS appraisal) and the title page/declarations; no protocol, PROSPERO or registration number anywhere in the text (searched protocol/PROSPERO/regist; the only 'registration' hits concern scan registration in the Results).

domains.evidence_quote: applied in the EMBASE, Scopus, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials databases
domains.note: four bibliographic databases: PubMed (MEDLINE), EMBASE, Scopus, Cochrane CENTRAL, plus a reference-list hand search; full PubMed strategy in Table 1.

domains.evidence_quote:
37 articles were identified to be analyzed by full-text. After the implementation of the exclusion criteria,
18 articles were identified to be eligible for final reporting.
domains.note: no list of the 19 excluded full texts with reasons; screening account with counts (315 → 286 → 37 full texts → 18 included, PRISMA Figure 1) and explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria in Methods are both reported (3b-iii line 2).

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote:
The risk of bias assessment was performed by the
Quality Assessment tool for Diagnostic Accuracy Studies (QUADAS).
domains.note: appraisal present (13 selected QUADAS items, Table 2) and per-study quality scores reported in Tables 3 to 6.

absent: read Materials and methods (no data synthesis or statistical analysis subsection), Results and Discussion; no meta-analysis, pooling, heterogeneity assessment or stated rationale for not pooling anywhere; the Results only state that studies were organized into 4 groups by denture bearing area and then report them study by study.
absent: read Materials and methods, Results, Discussion and Conclusion; no publication-bias, small-study, funnel-plot or grey-literature wording anywhere in the text.

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement / manufacturer funding without independent analysis
penalties.note: CoI statement present; no manufacturer funding reported.

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.note: not applicable: not an RCT (systematic review).

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: does not fire: the outcome is scan accuracy (trueness/precision) measured at a single point; the review makes no survival or success claim that would require follow-up.

sources.fact_fa: این مرور سیستماتیک امتیاز ۳۰ و باند D (شواهد ضعیف) را در نوع سؤال DIAGNOSTIC گرفته است.
sources.interpretation_fa: طراحی، مرور سیستماتیک با جست‌وجو در چهار پایگاه و ارزیابی کیفیت با QUADAS است، اما پروتکل ثبت‌شده، سنتز کمّی و بررسی publication bias ندارد و ضریب روش پایین آمده است. بیشتر مطالعات واردشده آزمایشگاهی‌اند. حاصل آن نقشه‌ای کیفی است: دقت IOS روی ریج و کام با مخاط چسبیده قابل قبول و روی بافت‌های متحرک حاشیه‌ای ناکافی گزارش شده است.

citation.title: Functional impression of complete edentulous arches in a digital flow: A scoping review
citation.authors: Thanh Vivan Nguyen, Murali Srinivasan, Adrien Naveau

s_design.anchor: Scoping review (PRISMA-ScR, PROSPERO-registered, three-database systematic search) of 12 non-randomized studies, 7 case reports and 12 technical articles on impression accuracy/recording methods; no meta-analysis (DIAGNOSTIC SR/MA row, 100, via Step 2 routing: design category is a systematic-search review; weakness of the pooled evidence is priced by AMSTAR-2)
s_design.evidence_quote: This scoping review aimed to summarize existing

domains.note: Registration on PROSPERO with a CRD number is affirmatively reported in Materials and methods.

domains.evidence_quote: The search strategy used in 3 biomedical literature databases, PubMed (National Library of Medicine), Scopus (Elsevier), and Dentistry
domains.note: Three bibliographic databases (MEDLINE via PubMed, Scopus, Dentistry & Oral Sciences Source), above the 2-database threshold; full search string in Table 2.

domains.evidence_quote: Following database screening and the removal of the duplicates, 184 articles were retrieved (Fig. 1). Of these, 139 were excluded based on
domains.note: No list of individually identified excluded full-text studies (14 full-text exclusions given only as counts by reason: 6, 3, 5), but (a) a screening account with counts and a PRISMA flowchart (Fig. 1) and (b) explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria in Materials and methods are both reported (3b-iii line 2).

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: Absent (branch 1, the text says it was not done): Materials and methods states 'No formal critical appraisal of individual sources was conducted'. Read Materials and methods (registration, search, eligibility, screening, synthesis, data charting), Results, Discussion and its limitations paragraph, and Conclusions; no quality, risk-of-bias or appraisal tool or step appears anywhere.

Absent (branch 1, the text says it was not done): Materials and methods states that no systematic review, meta-analysis, or quantitative synthesis was performed and data were summarised descriptively. Read Materials and methods, Results and Discussion; no pooling, effect model or heterogeneity test is described.

Absent: read Materials and methods, Results, Discussion (including the limitations paragraph) and Conclusions; no publication bias, small-study effect, funnel plot or related assessment is mentioned anywhere.

penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare that no financial/personal interest or belief that could affect their objectivity.
penalties.note: Declaration of competing interest present; Fundings section states the review received no external funding; no manufacturer funding.

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: The review's own claims are about impression accuracy (surface deviation) and whether a fully digital functional impression exists, not survival or long-term success; its text neither states nor summarizes a follow-up duration across included studies, and its limitations paragraph does not raise follow-up length. Individual case-report outcomes appear only in table cells.

sources.fact_fa: این مرور دامنه‌ای (scoping review) امتیاز ۳۰ و باند D (شواهد ضعیف) را در نوع سؤال DIAGNOSTIC می‌گیرد.
sources.interpretation_fa: جستجوی سیستماتیک در سه پایگاه و پروتکل ثبت‌شده در PROSPERO دارد، اما کیفیت مطالعات ارزیابی نشده، سنتز کمی و بررسی publication bias انجام نشده و همهٔ ۳۱ مطالعهٔ واردشده غیرتصادفی، case report یا مقاله‌ی تکنیکی‌اند. ارزشش نقشه‌برداری روش‌هاست: هیچ روش تمام‌دیجیتالی برای قالب‌گیری فانکشنال فک بی‌دندان گزارش نشده و دقت optical impression در بافت متحرک، به‌ویژه در مندیبل، محدود است.
